name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: SIGN-CHECKBOX-TRIGGER BUILD (v3), not for production: v0.4.21 still logged nothing at all from implementation.js, not even its own registration line. This build adds an unconditional first-line log statement to prove whether the script is executing at all, wraps the one previously-unguarded statement (Services.obs.addObserver) in try/catch so a throw there can't silently prevent the rest of the file (including the ExtensionAPI class) from loading, and has background.js call a new no-op certCleanup.ping() at startup in case Experiment parent scripts load lazily on first API access rather than eagerly with the add-on.
